summary: Derived a complete limited arithmetic estimate rather than importing the full external theorem. Reproved the elementary complete Kloosterman3/4 bound with explicit C(m)=(2*tau3(m)*m/phi(m))^(1/4) by fourth-moment collisions and the unit orbit. Interval completion after expanding v-coprimality to H gives the exact fixed-u Ramanujan main (V/u)*(phi(H)/H)*c_u(k), with errors tau_H*C(u)*u^(3/4)*gcd(k,u)^(1/4)*log(2u), including long, short and empty divisor intervals. Summed errors retain sigma_-3/4(|k|), while the main is O(V*tau(|k|)); no assumption k unit is made. Independently derived primitive both-unit count15UV*kappa_b(H)+O(tau_H*(U+V)*log(2U)). For U≈H^a,V≈H^b with b>3a/4 and polynomially bounded frequencies this yields normalized Fourier saving H^-min(a,b-3a/4)+o(1). A self-contained Fejer majorant argument gives interval discrepancy of the same power after choosing polynomial frequency cutoff; balanced sqrt(H) boxes give H^-1/8+o(1). Bounded-variation costs are explicit. This is cancellation for unweighted positions, not for primes, prescribed lists or high moments; no Goldbach proof, breakthrough or novelty claim is made. Separate review is pending.

claims.text: The complete Kloosterman bound (1) follows by the stated finite fourth-moment collision count and unit-scaling orbit, for all moduli and frequency gcds.
The fixed-u completion, summed Ramanujan formula, explicit frequency/divisor costs and primitive both-unit mass are established by the complete arguments in the statement.

In the declared polynomial box range, the stated unweighted complement-ratio Fourier and discrepancy power savings follow, including balanced sqrt(H) saving H^-1/8+o(1), with bounded-variation costs retained.
Actual-prime correlation, prescribed prime-list moments, the changed large-denominator major term, a Goldbach lower margin or demonstrated breakthrough remain unestablished by this estimate.
